name: Public Disclosure of Conflict of Interest Before a Vote
description: Anyone required to vote on a matter that would create a conflict of interest must abstain and publicly disclose the nature of the interest before the vote.
deadline: prior to the vote being taken
quote: Any Board member or District employee who, in the discharge of their official duties, would be required to vote on a matter that would result in a conflict of interest shall abstain from voting and, prior to the vote being taken, publicly announce and disclose the nature of their interest as a public record.
